specs.name: Property Setup Workbook
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: Single host-facing source of truth for every guest-relevant detail.
Includes the sections hosts most often forget (parking, quirks, quiet hours, emergency, nearest pharmacy).
Feeds the guest-facing Welcome Guide.

specs.name: Welcome Guide for Guests
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: Polished, guest-facing; no host-only operational detail.
Derived from the Property Setup Workbook.

specs.name: Master Turnover SOP
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: Covers the full turnover: entry, room-by-room reset, laundry, kitchen, bathrooms, supplies, damage check, final inspection.
States the guest-ready standard and an issue-escalation path.
Absorbs the former standalone step-by-step order (merged).

specs.name: Cleaner Handoff Sheet
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: A single sheet the cleaner completes each turnover.
Records issues and items to reorder.

specs.name: Quick Turnover Checklist
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: One-page field checklist condensed directly from the Master Turnover SOP.
Print-and-pin with checkboxes.

specs.name: Supply + Inventory Tracker
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: Reorder Status auto-flags when Current < Minimum (real formula).
Columns: property, category, item, location, current/min/reorder qty, status, last restocked, notes.
Usable in under 5 minutes with example rows to replace.

specs.name: Damage & Incident Log
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: Log each issue: area, severity, description, action taken, status, follow-up.
Distinct job from the tracker — 'what happened and is it resolved?'.
Simple; no legal or insurance claims.

specs.name: Guest Message Library
specs.maps_to_outcome: Run reliable, repeatable turnovers with less effort and fewer misses.

functional_requirements.req: Copy-paste templates for every booking stage.
Includes an issue-resolution / apology and a late-checkout snippet.
